fusions.name: Play with Your Food
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A pounce that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at the end of its reach, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Stolen Bites
fusions.desc: A swipe that deals 7 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Licked Clean
fusions.desc: Removes 1 condition from you and restores 10 health. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Saucer of Cream
fusions.desc: Every blow you dodge builds a stack, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
